responsibility: Implements the Rust frontend’s central cross-reference database between crates, AST nodes, HIR nodes, definitions, modules, macros, visibility, canonical paths, and language items. This file owns the concrete Mappings singleton behavior: allocation of crate/node/HIR/local-def identifiers, insertion and lookup of AST and HIR objects, parent-child module and impl associations, macro-definition wiring including builtin macro transcribers, location tracking, and auxiliary queries that later resolver, lowering, type-checking, privacy, and code-generation stages use to recover compiler objects from ids.
same_name_distinction: Provides the implementation of the NodeMapping and Mappings APIs, including singleton creation, id allocation, storage/lookup operations, macro wiring, visibility tracking, and module-child bookkeeping; unlike gcc/rust/util/rust-hir-map.h, this .cc file realizes those mapping services rather than declaring their data structures and entry points.
